name: Roller
description:
Roller is an open-source reverse-engineered source port of Fatal Racing (also known as Whiplash), the 1995 3D stunt racing game developed by Gremlin Interactive. It brings the high-speed loop-de-loop racer natively to modern PCs.

Features:
- Native 64-bit execution with high framerate rendering
- High-resolution display support with corrected aspect ratios and widescreen FOV
- Dynamic vehicular damage, car destruction, and pit-stop mechanics
- Modern gamepad and analog controller configuration alongside classic keyboard controls
- Requires original Fatal Racing / Whiplash game assets to run
